title: Agents Never Sleep — keep your Mac awake for long-running agents
excerpt: A macOS menu bar app that stops your Mac sleeping halfway through a job. Three levels, one slider: agents keep running while you're away, and with the lid closed.
content_html:
Agents keep running
with the lid closed

Never sleeps

Agents keep running while you're away,
and with the lid closed.

Drag it ↑

Lives in the
menu bar

As simple as
it gets

Native
and tiny

No data
collected

Stop this madness 🙅‍♂️, close the lid

It’s a whole genre at this point. What are we doing...

Questions

Why not just use caffeinate?

It doesn’t survive the closed lid.

What about Amphetamine?

Don’t do drugs, kids.

But I can just disable sleep in my terminal?

Absolutely. Here is the command:

sudo pmset -a disablesleep 1

Now just remember to turn it back on afterwards.Of course you won’t forget - you’re a smart one 😉

Can’t I just turn off sleep in System Settings?

Sure. Can you find where that setting is?

What if it doesn’t work for me?

Ask for a refund within 14 days and you get your money back. No form to fill in, no reason required.
